shipping: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and costs £4.99 (free on orders over £35). Express shipping takes 2-3 business days for £12.99. Bookly currently ships to the US and Canada only.
returns: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original condition. Digital/e-book purchases are final sale and non-returnable. Return shipping is free for defective or incorrect items; otherwise a £5.99 return label fee is deducted from the refund.
refunds: Once we receive and inspect a returned item, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days. Original shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to a Bookly error (wrong or damaged item).
password_reset: Customers can reset their password anytime from the Bookly login page via 'Forgot password'. Support can also trigger a reset email directly after verifying the customer's account email address.
payment: Bookly accepts Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and PayPal. We never store full card numbers, only the last 4 digits for reference.
account: Customers can update their name, shipping addresses, and email preferences from Account Settings. Changing the email on file requires verifying the current email first.
contact_human: If an issue can't be resolved by the agent, it can be escalated to a human support specialist, who typically responds within 1 business day.
